newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close down in depressed mood.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close down in depressed mood.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Portuguese shares closed down in depressed mood with foreign markets, influenced by concerns over the timing of the launch of EMU and fears of a possible U.S. rate rise, dealers said. Turnover was 8.3 billion escudos, about the average of recent sessions. Stocks affected by the negative sentiment included Sonae Investimentos, Banco Comercial Portugues, Cimpor and Portugal Telecom. Dealers said the trend tomorrow would depend on the close of Wall Street today and would be influenced by U.S. inflation data. "If the dollar continues to weaken and the New York market closes lower, Lisbon bourse will trade lower tomorrow," said one dealer.
